decisions.reason: The cited group exponent identities contain no order hypothesis or positivity conclusion. Replaced that citation by induction using d^0=1, d^{k+1}=d^k d and closure of positive integers under multiplication (thm-int-ordered-ring); addition preserves positivity of this nonempty finite sum. The defining formula, ranges n>=1 and k>=0, and integer-valued claim are unchanged.

F5 omitted the infinite-order alternative: the zero function cannot factor with g(a)!=0. Proof 3.1 already separates the constant case, so this is a nonfatal inaccurate fact rather than a failure of the asserted descent or decay. Qualified F5 by the locally zero alternative and aligned Proof 3.1 with it. Added thm-laurent-expansion-annulus to F6/deps for the Laurent-series existence used in Proof 4.1 and added its exact citation to the owning contract. Rotated local logs land in H by |q|<1; integer fibres and periodicity give descent and uniqueness; boundedness is equivalent to removability and yields O(q), including zero.

The original title assigned freeness to Gamma(2), although -I is in that matrix group and fixes all of H. Retitled the lemma to name barGamma(2). The Statement and Proof already retain the scalar kernel: nontrivial projective torsion would force even trace zero, then bc=-a^2-1=2 mod 4 contradicts b,c even. Finite PSL2(Z) stabilisers then imply every Gamma(2) stabiliser is {+/-I}. The B-page correctly says barGamma(2) acts freely. This is a nonfatal title correction with unchanged Statement and Proof.

For an intrinsic open cover of K=Dbar union {infinity}, a member around infinity contains K intersect B_N, not the ambient B_N. Rewrote Proof 2.1 intrinsically: this member covers the tail, traces of cover members form an intrinsic cover of L=Dbar intersect {Im tau<=N}, and Heine-Borel with the metric/topological compactness agreement gives finitely many more members. Added exact subspace and agreement suppliers and mirrored the derivation in the contract. The original geometric compactness argument is valid once the cover types are corrected, so this is nonfatal. The nonzero-c height bound gives the cusp chart and separates it from every interior orbit; finite interior charts and the nonzero exponential derivative supply the Riemann surface structure.

F1 incorrectly called M_12 closed under multiplication; two weight-12 forms multiply into weight 24. Its listed containments M_4 M_4 subset M_8, M_8 M_4 subset M_12 and M_6 M_6 subset M_12 were already correct and are exactly what Proof 1.1 uses. Replaced the erroneous phrase with the complex-vector-space property and weight addition. Checked E_4^3=1+720q+179280q^2 and E_6^2=1-1008q+220752q^2, giving Delta=q-24q^2. Nonnegative valence terms sum to 12/12-1=0, hence no interior zeros. The coefficient equations a+b=0 and 720a-1008b=0 prove independence, and dim M_12=2 gives the asserted basis. This is a nonfatal inaccurate fact with a sound proof and unchanged Statement.

F6 is false for disconnected covers: a permutation of sheets 2 and 3 in a trivial three-sheet cover fixes sheet 1. Its cited proposition explicitly assumes connected total space. Added that hypothesis and verified it in Proof 3.1 by straight segments in H. Each barGamma(2) element is a deck map; an arbitrary deck map agrees at a fixed point with one such element because fibres are Gamma(2)-orbits, hence agrees everywhere by connected-cover uniqueness. Thus the actual application was valid but its stated fact was overgeneralized, a nonfatal defect. Checked quotient bijectivity via labelled fibres and the degree-six rational identity (including repeated substitution values), strict-interior/weak-boundary height comparisons, and boundary substitutions x/(x-1)<0 and 1/x>1 with 0<x<1; reflection forces any real interior value into (0,1). Also declared def-modular-group-action-on-the-upper-half-plane, already cited in Given, to repair the scoped dependency warning.
